limits: The rollout request was accepted before the old revision drained and executed on the replacement; it was not deliberately killed after provider entry. Mid-tool crashes are covered by controlled tests.
Terminal runs discard their execution checkpoint; zero retained bytes is not a peak-size measurement. The 64,000-byte continuation bound is enforced and tested.
One user, 18 read-only requests over roughly 13 minutes; this does not establish multi-tenant capacity.
Todo digests may contain nonterminal item replies before the single terminal reply.
